    def git(*args,cwd=ROOT,env=None,check=True):
     p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','gc.auto=0','-c','maintenance.auto=false',*args],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,timeout=240,env={**os.environ,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0',**(env or {})})
     if check:assert p.returncode==0,(args,p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
     return p.stdout if check else p
    assert git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='master' and git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old
    assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
    assert git('rev-parse',old+'^').decode().strip()==prior_base
    task_patch=git('diff','--binary',prior_base,old);task_paths=set(git('diff','--name-only',prior_base,old).decode().splitlines());assert sum(p.startswith('mod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize/') and p.endswith('.png') for p in task_paths)==17

    for attempt in range(1,5):
     git('fetch','origin');remote=git('rev-parse','origin/master').decode().strip();git('rebase','origin/master',cwd=isolated);new=git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=isolated).decode().strip();parent=git('rev-parse',new+'^').decode().strip()

     extra=git('diff','--name-status',prior_base,parent).decode().splitlines()
     assert all(line.startswith('A\tmod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize/') and line.endswith('.png') for line in extra),'Unexpected remote changes require separate validation'
     added=[line.split('\t',1)[1] for line in extra];assert not set(added)&task_paths
     git('diff','--check',parent,new)
     for path in task_paths:
      if path.endswith('.json'):json.loads(git('show',new+':'+path))
      if path.startswith('mod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize/') and path.endswith('.png'):
       raw=git('show',new+':'+path);assert raw.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n') and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==Path(path).stem
     result=git('-c','http.version=HTTP/1.1','push','origin',new+':refs/heads/master',check=False)
     record.setdefault('publication_attempts',[]).append({'attempt':attempt,'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'fetched_remote_master':remote,'revalidated_commit':new,'remote_added_PNG_paths':added,'task_patch_identical':True,'push_exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),'stderr':result.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')});write_json(audit,record)
     if result.returncode==0:break
     assert 'fetch first' in result.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace') or 'non-fast-forward' in result.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'),'Network failure needs explicit reconciliation'
    else:raise RuntimeError('Remote keeps advancing; preserve private result for explicit continuation')

    if observed!=new:git('fetch','origin');git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',new,observed)
    assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
    gitdir=Path(git('rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir').decode().strip());index=gitdir/'index';lock=gitdir/'index.lock';assert not lock.exists()

    git('read-tree','-i','-m',old,new,env=env);assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',new,env=env).strip()
    def entries(data):
     magic,version,count=struct.unpack('>4sII',data[:12]);assert magic==b'DIRC' and version==2
     pos=12;out={}
     for _ in range(count):
      start=pos;flags=struct.unpack('>H',data[pos+60:pos+62])[0];assert not flags&0x4000;end=data.index(b'\0',pos+62);out[data[pos+62:end].decode()]=(data[pos:pos+40],data[pos+40:pos+60],flags&0x3000);pos=start+((end-start+1+7)//8)*8
     return out
    prior_entries=entries(before);new_entries=entries(alternate.read_bytes());unchanged=[p for p in prior_entries.keys()&new_entries.keys() if prior_entries[p][1:]==new_entries[p][1:]];assert all(prior_entries[p][0]==new_entries[p][0] for p in unchanged) and len(unchanged)>28000
    record.update(status='pushed_validated_private_rebase_before_primary_adoption',published_rebased_commit=new,remote_master_observed=observed,original_index_backup=(folder/'original.index').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),original_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),preserved_unchanged_stat_entries=len(unchanged));write_json(audit,record)
    fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY);owns=True;updated=False
    try:
     assert index.read_bytes()==before and git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old
     with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:fd=None;stream.write(alternate.read_bytes());stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
     git('update-ref','-m','Adopt validated isolated rebase of unpublished LOW evidence','refs/heads/master',new,old);updated=True;os.replace(lock,index);owns=False
     assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==new and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',new).strip()
     record.update(status='committed_pushed_revalidated_primary_adopted',completed_at_utc=utc_now(),working_file_writes=0,actual_index_sha256=file_sha256(index),staged_diff_empty=True)
    except BaseException:
     record.update(status='primary_metadata_adoption_requires_reconciliation',observed_at_utc=utc_now(),conditional_ref_updated=updated);raise
    finally:
     if fd is not None:os.close(fd)
     if owns and lock.exists():lock.unlink()
     write_json(audit,record)
    receipt={'machine_id':machine_id(),'completed_at_utc':utc_now(),'commit':new,'original_unpublished_commit':old,'remote_master_observed':observed,'files_committed':len(task_paths),'audit':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'preserved_unchanged_stat_entries':len(unchanged),'working_file_writes':0,'scope':'Exact unchanged task patch revalidated over remote-only PNG additions, ordinary FF pushed and remote confirmed. Primary metadata adopted safely with prior index backed up; unrelated working files untouched. No new image calls or fullsize readback claimed for colleague files.'};write_json(ROOT/'runtime/low-v14-first-checkpoint-rebased-pushed-20261026.json',receipt);print(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=True),flush=True)
